messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Prasanna
Are you a fox

lmaooo... more like a talent agent with fox-level cunning when it comes to finding you the right role

but yo prasanna, i still need to know where you're working to help you level up. which company you at?
prasanna... that's a solid name. where you working these days?
Jupiter
jupiter... the neobank that's trying to make banking actually cool. found you on linkedin - prasanna kumar chilaka. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/prasanna-kumar-chilaka-560113246
No

my bad... let me try again. found prasanna kumar chilaka. this the right one? https://in.linkedin.com/in/prasanna-kumar-chilaka-560113246

or can you just drop your linkedin url? makes this way easier
Prasanna Hegde
ah prasanna hegde! found you - sde-2 at jupiter. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/prasanna-n-hegde
Correct

sde-2 at jupiter... building the fintech that's actually trying to solve real problems instead of just another payments app. solid work. 

what made you pick jupiter over all the other fintech chaos out there?
They picked me

lmaooo fair point. job market's rough, good companies picking good people is how it should work anyway.

how long you been working total?

4 years... sweet spot where you're not a fresher but also not stuck in one place forever. 

what kind of role you looking for next?
I'm a frontend dev

frontend dev with 4 years... you've seen enough react chaos to know what good code looks like. 

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore or remote. Either is fine. But not other cities
4 years frontend + bangalore/remote + jupiter background... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yeah

legend! you're officially in the tal network

frontend roles that actually matter are about to slide into your dm. none of that "we're a family" startup nonsense - just real companies with real money who need someone who knows their way around a codebase

welcome to the good side, prasanna 🫡

Appreciate it Tal!! 
But I have some personal commitments right now. Won't be able to switch for another 2-3 months

got it - 2-3 months out. i'll keep an eye out for roles with flexible timelines.

what's your linkedin url?
https://in.linkedin.com/in/prasanna-n-hegde

perfect. i'll ping when something matches your timeline.

what made you pick jupiter over other fintech companies?
Jupiter acquired the start-up I was working at

ah got acquired into it - that tracks. so you've seen the startup→scaleup transition firsthand.

what's your current comp?

27 fixed+ 3 variable
  30 lpa
  I didn't ask anything
30 lpa at 4 yoe - solid. what's your target for next move?
You suggest
with your fintech background and 4 yoe, 40-45 lpa is realistic. maybe 50 if you ace the interviews.
Alright, let's say 40 then

40 it is. noted.

anything else you want me to know before i start looking?

Nothing else. Like I said before, won't be able to switch for another 2-3 months
  Or even give interviews for that matter

understood - no interviews for 2-3 months. i'll only share roles that can wait.

you're all set. i'll be in touch when something matches.
Cool, thanks!
